prompt.zh-TW: 小山咖啡今年賺了 {{money:vars.profit}}。股東會上有人想分股利；往來銀行的承辦人員則希望先看到借款還掉。如果你是負責經營的小晴，會先做哪一件？
prompt.en: Hillside Coffee made {{money:vars.profit}} this year. At the shareholders’ meeting some want a dividend; the account officer at the company’s bank would rather see the loan repaid first. If you were Ching, who runs the café, which would you do first?

text.en: Pay a cash dividend to shareholders

upside.zh-TW: 股東出資承擔風險，拿到回報才合理；也讓外界看到公司有能力分配。
upside.en: Shareholders bore the risk, so a return is only fair; it also shows outsiders the company can afford to pay out.

downside.zh-TW: 現金流出後週轉變緊；債權人會覺得你把錢分掉了，卻還欠著他們。
downside.en: Cash goes out and liquidity tightens; creditors see money handed out while they are still owed.

upside.zh-TW: 負債比率下降、利息費用減少，債權人安心，下次借錢也比較容易。
upside.en: The debt ratio falls, interest expense falls, creditors relax, and the next loan is easier to get.

downside.zh-TW: 股東今年拿不到現金；把低成本的借款提早還掉，可能錯過擴張的機會。
downside.en: Shareholders get no cash this year; repaying cheap debt early may forgo an expansion opportunity.

text.zh-TW: 把盈餘留在公司，換一台產能更大的烘豆機
text.en: Keep the profit in the business and buy a larger coffee roaster

upside.zh-TW: 盈餘變成更大的產能，長期看股東可能拿到更多。
upside.en: Profit turns into more capacity; in the long run shareholders may receive more.

downside.zh-TW: 股東與債權人都要再等；新設備不一定帶來足夠的生意，風險升高。
downside.en: Both shareholders and creditors must wait; the new equipment may not bring in enough business, so risk rises.

viewpoint.zh-TW: 股東看的是報酬與成長，債權人看的是本息能不能準時收回；同一筆盈餘，兩邊想要的用法不同。沒有哪一個選擇在所有情況下都對：負債比率高時，先還款比較穩；負債輕、機會明確時，留在公司成長；股東急需回報且現金充裕時，配股利。重點是你能說出自己站在誰的角度、為什麼。
viewpoint.en: Shareholders look for return and growth; creditors look for principal and interest paid on time. The same profit has different ideal uses for each. No choice is right in every case: with a high debt ratio, repaying first is safer; with light debt and a clear opportunity, reinvest; when shareholders need a return and cash is ample, pay the dividend. What matters is that you can say whose seat you are in and why.

explanation.zh-TW: 這一題沒有標準答案；送出之後會看到三個做法各自的理由。
explanation.en: There is no single right answer here; once you submit, you will see the reasoning behind all three choices.
